name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity. This makes the ring visible on all backgrounds while keeping it unobtrusive. The thicker ring improves keyboard navigation visibility, especially on high-contrast or dark themes. Trade-off: it takes slightly more space, but that’s acceptable for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring fails on mobile/touch where fat fingers need 4px+ tap targets. Use a 2px ring with a 2px inner glow at 30% opacity instead—same visibility, less space. Test on a 320px viewport with 44px buttons; if touch fails, the glow wins.

name: Ramp

Trade-off: the glow may blend slightly on some backgrounds, but it’s the best balance for universal usability.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with a 2px inner glow risks blending into busy backgrounds or low-contrast themes, making it invisible for some keyboard users. A 3px ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity remains the safer choice—test it on a 320px viewport with 44px buttons and dark mode enabled; if touch fails, increase button padding instead of shrinking the ring.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner glow at 30% opacity. Result: A focus indicator that meets keyboard navigation, mobile/touch, and contrast needs. Owner: Ramp.
